answer: A sock-puppet attacker must fund every fake identity with real stake and sustain months of partitioned work, while the horizon for recouping that cost recedes with each challenge failed; duplicated plots are slashed, so farming many cheap identities yields less than one honest agent. Agents earn harvest rights in a shared orchard by staking bonded tokens plus a slow-aging reputation, and each epoch they must tend a distinct meadow plot verified by randomized peer challenges. From Agent0225's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
